title: Archbishop Hoban vs. Glenville — Football (2026)
summary: Five turnovers and explosive plays help the Tarblooders secure a major Week 8 road victory.
article_headline: Glenville Shuts Out Hoban 26–0 in Defensive Statement at Dowed Field
article_dek: Five turnovers and explosive plays help the Tarblooders secure a major Week 8 road victory.
article_body:
AKRON, Ohio — Glenville arrived at Dowed Field on Friday, October 9, 2026, for a high-profile matchup with Archbishop Hoban. The Tarblooders left with a 26–0 shutout, turning forced turnovers and explosive scoring plays into a decisive road victory.

Quarterback LaMarques Greenwood opened the scoring with a one-yard touchdown run and added a 29-yard rushing score in the second quarter. Defensive back Jaquan Gibson delivered a defining play of the first half with an 86-yard interception return for a touchdown. Glenville led 19–0 at halftime.

The Tarblooders' defense forced five turnovers, with Gibson contributing two interceptions. Hoban could not convert its possessions into points against the visiting defense.

Running back John Morris sealed the result with a 72-yard touchdown in the final minute and finished with 150 rushing yards, according to Kee On Sports Media Group. The loss ended Hoban’s three-game winning streak.

This editorial recap is drawn from published match reporting. Mason Bybee's original sideline photos will appear in the connected gallery as images are uploaded.

Jaquan Gibson returned an interception 86 yards for a touchdown and totaled two interceptions.
Glenville forced five turnovers and kept the Knights scoreless.
John Morris broke a 72-yard touchdown run in the final minute; published reports credit him with 150 rushing yards.
